en: Chapter Two
zh_TW: 第二章

en: The Lord's Table
zh_TW: 城主的飯桌

en: The Lord's Table
zh_TW: 城主的飯桌

en: The lord of Daylight City has invited you to eat. Take a seat
zh_TW: 白晝城的城主請你們吃飯。去桌邊坐下

en: Ask Isa where Misha's brother is
zh_TW: 問伊薩，彌夏的弟弟在哪裡

en: Isa
zh_TW: 伊薩

en: (No poison. No ambush. Three plates of boiled beans, a pot of thin porridge, and four bowls — each one chipped in a different place.)
zh_TW: （沒有毒。沒有埋伏。三盤煮豆，一鍋稀粥，和四個缺口不一樣的碗。）

en: (The lord's name was Isa — a middle-aged man who hadn't shaved very well. When he pulled out our chairs, the metal brace on his right leg creaked.)
zh_TW: （城主名叫伊薩，是個鬍子刮得不乾淨的中年人。他替我們拉椅子時，右腿的金屬支架吱了一聲。）

en: Your hand — there's a very good doctor in the city. I'll ask her to come by.
zh_TW: 妳的手——城裡有位很好的醫師，我請她過來看看。

en: And you're the clockmaker looking for her brother. Have you found him?
zh_TW: 妳是來找弟弟的那位鐘匠吧。找到他了嗎？

en: Not yet.
zh_TW: 還沒。

en: The bell yard's shift runs until midnight today. You can wait for him here.
zh_TW: 鐘院的輪值今天到午夜。妳可以在這裡等他。

en: Why did he go into the bell yard?
zh_TW: 他為什麼進了鐘院？

en: (Isa didn't answer right away.)
zh_TW: （伊薩沒有立刻回答。）

en: (Misha put down her spoon.)
zh_TW: （彌夏放下湯匙。）

en: The Year-Eating Usurper
zh_TW: 食歲的僭王

en: Weak point: the heart
zh_TW: 弱點：心臟

en: Hold {key} — see through Isa
zh_TW: 按住 {key}　看穿伊薩

en: Follow Isa into the inner room of the bell yard
zh_TW: 跟著伊薩走進鐘院內室

en: He volunteered.
zh_TW: 他自願的。

en: Then let him out. Right now.
zh_TW: 那你讓他現在出來。

en: I can't.
zh_TW: 我做不到。

en: The bell… that was me. I'm sorry.
zh_TW: 鐘的事……是我做的。對不起。

en: (Say nothing.)
zh_TW: （什麼都沒說。）

en: The bell… that was me. I'm sorry.
zh_TW: 鐘的事……是我做的。對不起。

en: …Eat first. The soup is getting cold.
zh_TW: ……先吃吧。湯要涼了。

en: (I looked at the beans and said nothing.)
zh_TW: （我看著那盤豆子，什麼都沒說。）

en: (The soup on the table slowly went cold.)
zh_TW: （桌上的湯慢慢涼了。）

en: Come with me. You should see him.
zh_TW: 跟我來。妳該見他一面。

en: Leo
zh_TW: 黎歐

en: Misha's brother is in the inner room
zh_TW: 彌夏的弟弟在內室裡

en: Look at the carvings on the wall
zh_TW: 看牆上的紋路

en: Misha's brother was called Leo. Seventeen, with her eyes. He sat in a copper chair, and a dozen thin tubes ran from his back into a great bell dial on the wall.
zh_TW: 彌夏的弟弟叫黎歐。十七歲，眉眼和她很像，坐在一張銅椅裡，背後十幾條細管接進牆上的巨大鐘盤。

en: He saw his sister, and smiled first.
zh_TW: 他看見姊姊，先笑了。

en: You cut your hair.
zh_TW: 妳剪頭髮了。

en: Misha stayed in the doorway. She didn't take a single step.
zh_TW: 彌夏站在門口，一步都沒有走。

en: I said in my letter not to come. Did the fish eat that part?
zh_TW: 我信裡說別來。魚是不是把那段吃掉了？

en: She walked over to him,
zh_TW: 她走過去，

en: and slapped him.
zh_TW: 給了他一巴掌。

en: Not hard. The same hand came up at once to hold his face, as if she were afraid he would break.
zh_TW: 不重。打完立刻用同一隻手捧住他的臉，像怕把他碰碎。

en: Press {key} — look at the carving
zh_TW: 按 {key}　看牆上的紋路

en: Ask Isa if there's another way
zh_TW: 問伊薩還有沒有別的辦法

en: (The first slab: people pressing something shapeless down into the earth, and a bell set on top of it.)
zh_TW: （第一塊：一群人把一個看不清形狀的東西壓進地底，上面蓋著一口鐘。）

en: Seventeen years ago, the kingdom above sealed the monsters from the deep in here.
zh_TW: 十七年前，地上的王國把深層的魔物封在這裡。

en: (The second slab: a line of people with their hands on the bell. Above the bell, a net spreads open.)
zh_TW: （第二塊：排隊的人把手按在鐘上，鐘的上方張開一層網。）

en: The bell turns people's years into a barrier. Everyone thought it was only for a while, until help came from above.
zh_TW: 鐘能把人的壽命轉成屏障。大家以為只是暫時的，等地上派人來救，就能停。

en: No one came.
zh_TW: 沒有人來。

en: (The third slab: a chair, a person in it, and a row of small marks beside it, one in every three.)
zh_TW: （第三塊：一張椅子、椅子上的人，旁邊刻著一排小小的記號，每三格一個。）

en: The bell only takes the days people choose to give. But every three years, someone has to sit in the Main Seat and carry everything that's lost along the way.
zh_TW: 鐘只收大家自願付的日數。但每三年，必須有人坐進主椅，承受轉換時所有的損耗。

en: Leo took the seat three months ago.
zh_TW: 黎歐三個月前接了位置。

en: (The last slab: the bell struck nine times, and the whole city on fire.)
zh_TW: （最後一塊：鐘被敲了九下，整座城燒起來。）

en: Once you took out the clapper, the bell stopped holding back how much it takes.
zh_TW: 你們拆下鐘舌之後，鐘就不再控制一次收多少了。

en: Nine strikes is the order the kingdom left behind for an emergency: burn the whole city.
zh_TW: 敲滿九聲，是王國預留的緊急命令：燒掉整座城。

en: (Now I finally understood why my guide had always worked so well.)
zh_TW: （我終於理解，自己的攻略為什麼那麼有效。）

en: (The monsters were never burned by players.)
zh_TW: （怪物不是被玩家燒死的。）

en: (The whole city paid for that strike.)
zh_TW: （是整座城替玩家付了那一擊的費用。）
